text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Housing and Development (Design‑Build‑and‑Sell Scheme — Vesting) (No. 2) Notification 2014.

heading.en: Vesting of reversion, etc., in Board

text.en:
2. The Minister, in respect of the housing accommodation built on the parcel of land specified in the first column of the Schedule by the approved developer specified opposite in the second column, hereby declares that the following shall vest in the Board:
(a)the reversion immediately expectant on the lease of every housing accommodation sold by the approved developer; and
(b)the entire estate in the common property built by the approved developer on that same parcel of land.
